data.revised_prompt: Simple centered icon asset, bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, readable at small sizes. Create a high-quality 3D chibi-style educational app avatar of a fictional Chinese schoolgirl aged about 8–14, clearly a student. Square 1:1 composition, tightly focused on the head with only a tiny amount of shoulder and neck visible at the bottom; not a half-body portrait. The face and hair together should occupy about 75%–85% of the canvas. Front view or slight three-quarter view. Full hair outline visible with no cropping of the top, sides, or chin. Character details: neat chin-length straight bob haircut, short bangs above the eyebrows, two thin mint-green hair clips crossed on the right side; slightly clever expression with a small toothy smile; bright brown eyes. Soft studio lighting, refined modeling, soft materials, high-quality 3D render, youthful school student appearance. Bottom edge shows only a small amount of white school-style collar, with no badge or text. Background must be fully filled edge-to-edge across the entire square canvas, from all sides and corners, no white border, no transparency, no circular frame, no ring, no halo, no scene. Use a full-coverage low-saturation gray-blue background. Avoid: half body, upper body, full body, hands, gestures, props, teacher, adult, headset, earphones, suit, heavy makeup, jewelry, head crop, hair crop, chin crop, face too small, off-center, large shoulders, white background, white border, transparent, circular background, avatar frame, ring, strong glow, complex scene, text, letters, numbers, school emblem, logo, watermark, multiple characters, real photo, flat 2D illustration, baby proportions, dark tone, low clarity, distorted facial features.
